ex.s: Beyond this, you can keep healthy by consuming different categories of fresh foods, especially fruit and vegetables, which are full of vitamins and fibre, rather than processed foods.
ex.t: 除此之外，你可以通过摄入不同种类的新鲜食物来保持健康，特别是富含维生素和纤维的水果和蔬菜，而不是加工食品。
